name: elevenlabs/v4-turbo
description: Eleven v4 Turbo is the low-latency tier of ElevenLabs' v4 text-to-speech generation, for real-time and high-volume narration.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for best-effort reproducibility. Identical output is not guaranteed.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to convert to speech. Supports audio tags such as [whispering] and IPA pronunciation enclosed in forward slashes.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice to use for speech generation

stability.title: Stability
stability.description: Voice stability. Lower values allow more expressive delivery; higher values make delivery more consistent.

timestamps.title: Timestamps
timestamps.description: Whether to return character-level timing information with the generated audio.

language_code.title: Language Code
language_code.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) for speech generation and text normalization.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate.

similarity_boost.title: Similarity Boost
similarity_boost.description: How closely the output follows the reference voice. Higher values increase similarity but may reduce naturalness.

apply_text_normalization.title: Apply Text Normalization
apply_text_normalization.description: Whether to normalize text such as numbers and dates before generation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# ElevenLabs Eleven v4 Turbo

Eleven v4 Turbo, the low-latency v4 tier for real-time and high-volume narration.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string, required | — | Text to speak. |
| `output_format` | `mp3_22050_32` / `mp3_44100_32` / `mp3_44100_64` / `mp3_44100_96` / `mp3_44100_128` / `mp3_44100_192` / `opus_48000_32` / `opus_48000_64` / `opus_48000_96` / `opus_48000_128` / `opus_48000_192` | `mp3_44100_128` | Output file format. |
| `seed` | integer 0–4294967295 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `stability` | number 0–1 | 0.5 | Lower is more expressive; higher is more consistent. |
| `similarity_boost` | number 0–1 | 0.75 | How closely to match the voice. |
| `apply_text_normalization` | `auto` / `on` / `off` | `auto` | Whether to normalize text such as numbers and dates before generation. |
| `language_code` | string | — | Force a language. |
| `timestamps` | boolean | false | Return word timings. |
| `voice` | string | `Rachel` | Voice name or ID. |

## Billing

$0.04 per started 1,000 characters, with a one-unit minimum.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 200 characters | $0.04 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.04 |
| 2,500 characters | $0.12 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Use punctuation and line breaks to shape pauses.

## Also on SandBase

Other ElevenLabs voices: `elevenlabs/v4`, `elevenlabs/v3`, `elevenlabs/multilingual-v2`.
